description: This Dart source file defines the HomeScreen widget for a Flutter news application. It manages the tabbed layout for different news categories, provides navigation to other screens (Saved News, Notification Test, Device Token), and displays error messages from application state.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget representing the main screen with tab navigation for news categories.

classes.name: _HomeMenuAction
classes.description: An enum representing actions in the overflow menu (Device Token, Notification Test).

classes.name: _CategoryTabSpec
classes.description: A simple data holder class for a tab's title and widget.

methods.description: Constructs the widget tree for the HomeScreen, including AppBar with actions, TabBar, and TabBarView.
